title: Words and patterns
description: Kept out of what agents send. Only the user's own text is read, not tool results, tool calls or the system prompt, so a file an agent reads that contains a word doesn't stop it. Nothing happens while both lists are empty.
words.label: Words
words.hint: Matched anywhere in the text, ignoring case.
patterns.label: Patterns
patterns.hint: Regular expressions, matched ignoring case, such as \b\d{3}-\d{4}\b.
patterns.error: "{pattern}" is not a valid regular expression, so the patterns were not saved.
action.title: What to do
action.label: Action
action.hint: Turn the request away with a 400 that names the word, or replace each match and send the request on.
message.label: Error text
message.hint: Used in place of the default message when a request is turned away. Empty keeps the default.
mask.label: Mask
mask.hint: What each match is replaced with when masking.
check.label: Which messages
check.hint: The last message reads only the last user message that has text, the turn being sent (what New API reads). All reads every user message, so a word earlier in the conversation keeps turning requests away.
replies.label: Mask replies too
replies.hint: Only with the Mask action. Masks matches in the text that comes back, streamed or whole, in every API. A word split across two streamed events isn't caught.
